dataset: Rulers of Russia History Core research queue
rules: A boundary change is not production-ready until its effective date and geometry are both source-backed.
Search Russian archival/original and official documentary sources first.
A modern retrospective map may suggest where to research but cannot establish canonical geometry.
Signing, ratification, entry into force, demarcation and actual transfer of control are separate dates when documents distinguish them.
Do not invent day or month precision.
For periods without a documented linear border, model a frontier/control/tributary zone and expose uncertainty.

phases.goal: Legal boundary chronology of the Russian Federation with separate de-facto/control/claim tracks where required.
External USSR boundary changes plus union-republic changes that later affected the Russian Federation; keep wartime front lines separate.
Separate legal claims, effective control, fronts and recognized borders during revolution and civil war.
Event-sourced external boundary chronology of the Russian Empire down to exact effective date where documents permit.
documentFamilies: Military Topographic Depot / General Staff maps

phases.goal: Treaty- and act-based chronology of the Russian Tsardom; represent weakly delimited frontier areas as zones.
Reconstruct documented acquisitions, dependencies and frontier zones without projecting a modern state-border concept backward.
Build a source-critical territorial model of lands, tribute, dynastic control and frontier zones; avoid false precise polygons.
phases.precisionPolicy: Month-level state is only produced where documentary dating actually supports month/day precision; otherwise the UI must show the uncertainty/range.
